verses.en: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.pt: Pergunto, pois: Acaso rejeitou Deus ao seu povo? De modo nenhum; por que eu também sou israelita, da descendência de Abraão, da tribo de Benjamim.
verses.en_web: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.en_bbe: So I say, Has God put his people on one side? Let there be no such thought. For I am of Israel, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.en: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
verses.pt: Deus não rejeitou ao seu povo que antes conheceu. Ou não sabeis o que a Escritura diz de Elias, como ele fala a Deus contra Israel, dizendo:
verses.en_web: God didn’t reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:
verses.en_bbe: God has not put away the people of his selection. Or have you no knowledge of what is said about Elijah in the holy Writings? how he says words to God against Israel,

verses.en: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.pt: Senhor, mataram os teus profetas, e derribaram os teus altares; e só eu fiquei, e procuraram tirar-me a vida?
verses.en_web: “Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.”
verses.en_bbe: Lord, they have put your prophets to death, and made waste your altars, and now I am the last, and they are searching for me to take away my life.

verses.en: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.pt: Mas que lhe diz a resposta divina? Reservei para mim sete mil varões que não dobraram os joelhos diante de Baal.
verses.en_web: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”
verses.en_bbe: But what answer does God make to him? I have still seven thousand men whose knees have not been bent to Baal.

verses.en: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.pt: Assim, pois, também no tempo presente ficou um remanescente segundo a eleição da graça.
verses.en_web: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.en_bbe: In the same way, there are at this present time some who are marked out by the selection of grace.

verses.en: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.pt: Mas se é pela graça, já não é pelas obras; de outra maneira, a graça já não é graça.
verses.en_web: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.
verses.en_bbe: But if it is of grace, then it is no longer of works: or grace would not be grace.

verses.en: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
verses.pt: Pois quê? O que Israel busca, isso não o alcançou; mas os eleitos alcançaram; e os outros foram endurecidos,
verses.en_web: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.
verses.en_bbe: What then? That which Israel was searching for he did not get, but those of the selection got it and the rest were made hard.

verses.en: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.pt: como está escrito: Deus lhes deu um espírito entorpecido, olhos para não verem, e ouvidos para não ouvirem, até o dia de hoje.
verses.en_web: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”
verses.en_bbe: As it was said in the holy Writings, God gave them a spirit of sleep, eyes which might not see, and ears which have no hearing, to this day.

verses.en: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.pt: E Davi diz: Torne-se-lhes a sua mesa em laço, e em armadilha, e em tropeço, e em retribuição;
verses.en_web: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.
verses.en_bbe: And David says, Let their table be made a net for taking them, and a stone in their way, and a punishment:

verses.en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.pt: escureçam-se-lhes os olhos para não verem, e tu encurva-lhes sempre as costas.
verses.en_web: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.”
verses.en_bbe: Let their eyes be made dark so that they may not see, and let their back be bent down at all times.

verses.en: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.pt: Logo, pergunto: Porventura tropeçaram de modo que caíssem? De maneira nenhuma, antes pelo seu tropeço veio a salvação aos gentios, para os incitar à emulação.
verses.en_web: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.en_bbe: So I say, Were their steps made hard in order that they might have a fall? In no way: but by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, so that they might be moved to envy.

verses.en: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.pt: Ora se o tropeço deles é a riqueza do mundo, e a sua diminuição a riqueza dos gentios, quanto mais a sua plenitude!
verses.en_web: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?
verses.en_bbe: Now, if their fall is the wealth of the world, and their loss the wealth of the Gentiles, how much greater will be the glory when they are made full?

verses.en: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.pt: Mas é a vós, gentios, que falo; e, porquanto sou apóstolo dos gentios, glorifico o meu ministério,
verses.en_web: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;
verses.en_bbe: But I say to you, Gentiles, in so far as I am the Apostle of the Gentiles, I make much of my position:

verses.en: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.pt: para ver se de algum modo posso incitar à emulação os da minha raça e salvar alguns deles.
verses.en_web: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.
verses.en_bbe: If in any way those who are of my flesh may be moved to envy, so that some of them may get salvation by me.

verses.en: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.pt: Porque, se a sua rejeição é a reconciliação do mundo, qual será a sua admissão, senão a vida dentre os mortos?
verses.en_web: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?
verses.en_bbe: For, if by their putting away, the rest of men have been made friends with God, what will their coming back again be, but life from the dead?

verses.en: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.pt: Se as primícias são santas, também a massa o é; e se a raiz é santa, também os ramos o são.
verses.en_web: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.
verses.en_bbe: And if the first-fruit is holy, so is the mass: and if the root is holy, so are the branches.

verses.en: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.pt: E se alguns dos ramos foram quebrados, e tu, sendo zambujeiro, foste enxertado no lugar deles e feito participante da raiz e da seiva da oliveira,
verses.en_web: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;
verses.en_bbe: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, an olive-tree of the fields, were put in among them, and were given a part with them in the root by which the olive-tree is made fertile,

verses.en: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.pt: não te glories contra os ramos; e, se contra eles te gloriares, não és tu que sustentas a raiz, mas a raiz a ti.
verses.en_web: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be uplifted in pride over the branches: because it is not you who are the support of the root, but it is by the root that you are supported.

verses.en: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.pt: Dirás então: Os ramos foram quebrados, para que eu fosse enxertado.
verses.en_web: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”
verses.en_bbe: You will say, Branches were broken off so that I might be put in.

verses.en: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.pt: Está bem; pela sua incredulidade foram quebrados, e tu pela tua fé estás firme. Não te ensoberbeças, mas teme;
verses.en_web: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;
verses.en_bbe: Truly, because they had no faith they were broken off, and you have your place by reason of your faith. Do not be lifted up in pride, but have fear;

verses.en: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.pt: porque, se Deus não poupou os ramos naturais, não te poupará a ti.
verses.en_web: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.
verses.en_bbe: For, if God did not have mercy on the natural branches, he will not have mercy on you.

verses.en: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.pt: Considera pois a bondade e a severidade de Deus: para com os que caíram, severidade; para contigo, a bondade de Deus, se permaneceres nessa bondade; do contrário também tu serás cortado.
verses.en_web: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.
verses.en_bbe: See then that God is good but his rules are fixed: to those who were put away he was hard, but to you he has been good, on the condition that you keep in his mercy; if not, you will be cut off as they were.

verses.en: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
verses.pt: E ainda eles, se não permanecerem na incredulidade, serão enxertados; porque poderoso é Deus para os enxertar novamente.
verses.en_web: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.
verses.en_bbe: And they, if they do not go on without faith, will be united to the tree again, because God is able to put them in again.

verses.en: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.pt: Pois se tu foste cortado do natural zambujeiro, e contra a natureza enxertado em oliveira legítima, quanto mais não serão enxertados na sua própria oliveira esses que são ramos naturais!
verses.en_web: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.en_bbe: For if you were cut out of a field olive-tree, and against the natural use were united to a good olive-tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be united again with the olive-tree which was theirs?

verses.en: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.pt: Porque não quero, irmãos, que ignoreis este mistério (para que não presumais de vós mesmos): que o endurecimento veio em parte sobre Israel, até que a plenitude dos gentios haja entrado;
verses.en_web: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,
verses.en_bbe: For it is my desire, brothers, that this secret may be clear to you, so that you may not have pride in your knowledge, that Israel has been made hard in part, till all the Gentiles have come in;

verses.en: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.pt: e assim todo o Israel será salvo, como está escrito: Virá de Sião o Libertador, e desviará de Jacó as impiedades;
verses.en_web: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.
verses.en_bbe: And so all Israel will get salvation: as it is said in the holy Writings, There will come out of Zion the One who makes free; by him wrongdoing will be taken away from Jacob:

verses.en: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.pt: e este será o meu pacto com eles, quando eu tirar os seus pecados.
verses.en_web: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”
verses.en_bbe: And this is my agreement with them, when I will take away their sins.

verses.en: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sakes.
verses.pt: Quanto ao evangelho, eles na verdade, são inimigos por causa de vós; mas, quanto à eleição, amados por causa dos pais.
verses.en_web: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.
verses.en_bbe: As far as the good news is in question, they are cut off from God on account of you, but as far as the selection is in question, they are loved on account of the fathers.

verses.en: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.pt: Porque os dons e a vocação de Deus são irretratáveis.
verses.en_web: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.
verses.en_bbe: Because God's selection and his mercies may not be changed.

verses.en: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.pt: Pois, assim como vós outrora fostes desobedientes a Deus, mas agora alcançastes misericórdia pela desobediência deles,
verses.en_web: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
verses.en_bbe: For as you, in time past, were not under the rule of God, but now have got mercy through their turning away,

verses.en: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.pt: assim também estes agora foram desobedientes, para também alcançarem misericórdia pela misericórdia a vós demonstrada.
verses.en_web: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.
verses.en_bbe: So in the same way these have gone against the orders of God, so that by the mercy given to you they may now get mercy.

verses.en: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.pt: Porque Deus encerrou a todos debaixo da desobediência, a fim de usar de misericórdia para com todos.
verses.en_web: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.
verses.en_bbe: For God has let them all go against his orders, so that he might have mercy on them all.

verses.en: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
verses.pt: Ó profundidade das riquezas, tanto da sabedoria, como da ciência de Deus! Quão insondáveis são os seus juízos, e quão inescrutáveis os seus caminhos!
verses.en_web: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
verses.en_bbe: O how deep is the wealth of the wisdom and knowledge of God! no one is able to make discovery of his decisions, and his ways may not be searched out.

verses.en: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
verses.pt: Pois, quem jamais conheceu a mente do Senhor? ou quem se fez seu conselheiro?
verses.en_web: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”
verses.en_bbe: Who has knowledge of the mind of the Lord? or who has taken part in his purposes?

verses.en: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
verses.pt: Ou quem lhe deu primeiro a ele, para que lhe seja recompensado?
verses.en_web: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”
verses.en_bbe: Or who has first given to him, and it will be given back to him again?

verses.en: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
verses.pt: Porque dele, e por ele, e para ele, são todas as coisas; glória, pois, a ele eternamente. Amém.
verses.en_web: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.
verses.en_bbe: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever. So be it.
